description:
Follow-up to JMAP-sc1b.18 (which landed the workspace bench convention and the canonical bench in crate-jmap-server).

The base client in jmap-base-client is the third of three crates the .sc1b.18 review identified as worth benchmarking (URL building, session JSON deserialization, blob URL construction).

Pattern to copy from crate-jmap-server:
1. Add to crate-jmap-base-client/Cargo.toml [dev-dependencies]:
     criterion = { version = '0.8', default-features = false, features = ['cargo_bench_support'] }
2. Add to crate-jmap-base-client/Cargo.toml:
     [[bench]]
     name = '<bench-name>'
     harness = false
3. Create crate-jmap-base-client/benches/<bench-name>.rs with criterion harness.

Suggested workloads:
- Session response JSON deserialization (typical and large account-id list).
- Blob URL construction (template parameter substitution).
- Capability URI lookup against a typical session capabilities map.

Run with: cargo bench -p jmap-base-client

Acceptance: at least one benches/<file>.rs target that compiles, runs to completion, and reports timings for at least three workloads.
notes: De-labeling human (2026-05-11, Mark): implementation chore. Bench pattern is fully documented in the bead body (copy from crate-jmap-server canonical bench). Workload suggestions provided. No pending decision.
title: Add criterion benches/ to crate-jmap-base-client (URL/JSON serde for session fetch)
